news.title: FBI arrests Atlanta mass shooting suspect in Atlanta
news.summary: An FBI SWAT team arrested a suspect in the deadly Atlanta mass shooting in Atlanta at a house in Alabama on Wednesday.

news.title: MARTA bus involved in crash near Langhorn Street and I-20
news.summary: Officers are on scene investigating a crash involving a MARTA bus near Langhorn Street on Wednesday night, according to the Atlanta Police Department.

news.title: Suspect arrested after chase ends in PIT maneuver on I-75 in Whitfield County
news.summary: A multi-county chase ended on I-75 South in Whitfield County after deputies performed a PIT maneuver to stop the suspect on Wednesday afternoon, according to the sheriff's office.

news.title: 14-time convicted felon sentenced to federal prison for stolen gun
news.summary: A 14-time convicted felon with a decades-long violent criminal record has been sentenced to nearly nine years in federal prison after Atlanta police caught him with a stolen gun.

news.title: Georgia Supreme Court keeps stay in place for death row inmate, meaning execution will not happen Wednesday
news.summary: Late Tuesday, a Cobb County judge paused the execution to allow time for a hearing on whether the Survivor Justice Act applies to Humphreys' case.

news.title: Georgia Tech student missing since Sunday; police ask public to check video
news.summary: Georgia Tech police are asking for the public’s help finding a first-year student who has been missing since Sunday.

news.title: Mother pleads for answers in 2022 murder of Georgia State freshman
news.summary: An Atlanta family stood side-by-side with police officers on Wednesday to plead for the community's help in solving the December 2022 murder of a 19-year-old college student.

news.title: Suspect wanted in connection with Edgewood Ave. mass shooting arrested out of state
news.summary: FBI Atlanta said Ze'Kevious Perry was taken into custody at a home in Montgomery, Alabama. An FBI SWAT team made the arrest.

news.title: Death row inmate’s stay of execution upheld by Georgia Supreme Court
news.summary: The Cobb County District Attorney’s Office had filed an appeal with the high court in response to the stay of execution ordered for Stacey Humphreys.

news.title: Atlanta high school football coach arrested after fight at game
news.summary: A high school football coach is out on bond after allegedly punching and shoving an opposing player during a fight on the field in Carroll County.

news.title: Third suspect captured in deadly 2025 Sweet Auburn mass shooting
news.summary: Federal authorities have captured the third person wanted in connection with the 2025 Sweet Auburn mass shooting that left one man dead and 10 other people injured.

news.title: Family desperate for answers nearly 4 years after 19-year-old killed in Atlanta apartment shooting
news.summary: The family has also been distributing flyers throughout the apartment complex, hoping someone who knows what happened will provide information.

news.title: Man arrested in deadly shooting of 62-year-old found in Lithonia carport
news.summary: DeKalb County police have arrested a 27-year-old man in connection with the fatal shooting of a homeowner found dead in his Lithonia carport in July.

news.title: Georgia high court upholds stay of execution for Stacey Humphreys
news.summary: The Georgia Supreme Court has upheld a Cobb County judge’s ruling putting the execution of death row inmate Stacey Ian Humphreys on hold.

news.title: Georgia death row inmate has clemency hearing today, with other legal challenges ongoing before execution scheduled for tomorrow
news.summary: It's unclear how likely any path would give a reprieve to Stacey Humphreys, who was convicted of killing two women in Cobb County in 2003.

news.title: Partner of Atlanta man found dead in Birmingham in 2024 charged with his murder
news.summary: Police said 31-year-old Deundray Cottrell was last seen on July 4, 2024, at a house in the South East Lake neighborhood.
